mapper.select:
WITH /* isry.itgcm.bizcmmns.cmmns.TrprIdntfcMapper.selectTrprIdntfcList(대상자식별조회) */ V_TRPR_IDNTFC AS ( SELECT T1.TRPR_INFO_NO AS TRPR_INFO_NO -- 대상자정보번호(TR) , T1.INDV_IDNTFC_NO AS INDV_IDNTFC_NO -- 개인식별번호 , T1.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD AS UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD -- 단위업무구분코드 , CASE WHEN T1.INDV_IDNTFC_NO IS NOT NULL THEN NVL(T2.FLNM_ENCPT, T1.TRPR_NM_ENCPT) ELSE T1.TRPR_NM_ENCPT END AS TRPR_NM -- 대상자명 , CASE WHEN T1.INDV_IDNTFC_NO IS NOT NULL THEN NVL(T2.RRNO_ENCPT, T1.TRPR_BRTH_YMD) ELSE T1.TRPR_BRTH_YMD END AS TRPR_BRTH_YMD -- 대상자출생일자 , CASE WHEN T1.INDV_IDNTFC_NO IS NOT NULL THEN NVL(T2.SXDC_SE_CD, T1.SXDC_SE_CD) ELSE T1.SXDC_SE_CD END AS SXDC_SE_CD -- 성별구분코드 , CASE WHEN T1.INDV_IDNTFC_NO IS NOT NULL THEN NVL(T2.MRG_YN, T1.MRG_YN) ELSE T1.MRG_YN END AS MRG_YN -- 결혼여부 , CASE WHEN T1.INDV_IDNTFC_NO IS NOT NULL THEN NVL(T2.WRD_TELNO, T1.TRPR_TELNO_ENCPT) ELSE T1.TRPR_TELNO_ENCPT END AS TRPR_TELNO /* 대상자전화번호 */ , CASE WHEN T1.INDV_IDNTFC_NO IS NOT NULL THEN NVL(T2.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT, T1.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) ELSE T1.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT END AS MBL_TELNO -- 휴대전화번호 , CASE WHEN T1.INDV_IDNTFC_NO IS NOT NULL THEN NVL(T2.EML_ADDR_ENCPT, T1.EML_ADDR_ENCPT) ELSE T1.EML_ADDR_ENCPT END AS EML_ADDR -- 이메일주소 , CASE WHEN T1.INDV_IDNTFC_NO IS NOT NULL THEN NVL(T2.SNS_SE_CD, T1.SNS_SE_CD) ELSE T1.SNS_SE_CD END AS SNS_SE_CD -- SNS구분코드 , CASE WHEN T1.INDV_IDNTFC_NO IS NOT NULL THEN NVL(T2.MSNGR_ID_ENCPT, T1.MSNGR_ID_ENCPT) ELSE T1.MSNGR_ID_ENCPT END AS MSNGR_ID -- 메신저아이디 , CASE WHEN T1.INDV_IDNTFC_NO IS NOT NULL THEN NVL(T2.ZIP, T1.ZIP) ELSE T1.ZIP END AS ZIP -- 우편번호 , CASE WHEN T1.INDV_IDNTFC_NO IS NOT NULL THEN NVL(T2.PST_ADDR, T1.PST_ADDR) ELSE T1.PST_ADDR END AS PST_ADDR -- 우편주소 , CASE WHEN T1.INDV_IDNTFC_NO IS NOT NULL THEN NVL(T2.DADDR, T1.DADDR) ELSE T1.DADDR END AS DADDR -- 상세주소 , T1.ACBG_SE_CD AS ACBG_SE_CD -- 학력구분코드 , T1.GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD AS GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD -- 졸업상태구분코드 , T1.GRADE_SE_CD AS GRADE_SE_CD -- 학년구분코드 , T1.PSPT_ENG_FLNM_ENCPT AS PSPT_ENG_FLNM -- 여권영문성명 , T1.TRPR_BCRN_TYPE_SE_CD AS TRPR_BCRN_TYPE_SE_CD -- 대상자배경유형구분코드 , T1.TRPR_BCRN_TYPE_RM_NM AS TRPR_BCRN_TYPE_RM_NM -- 대상자배경유형비고명 , T1.NLTY_NTN_SE_CD AS NLTY_NTN_SE_CD -- 국적국가구분코드 , T1.ENTCNY_YMD AS ENTCNY_YMD -- 입국일자 , T1.BRTH_NTN_SE_CD AS BRTH_NTN_SE_CD -- 출생국가구분코드 , T1.GROWTH_NTN_SE_CD AS GROWTH_NTN_SE_CD -- 성장국가구분코드 , T1.VISA_TYPE_SE_CD AS VISA_TYPE_SE_CD -- 비자유형구분코드 , T1.HANAWO_PENU_NO AS HANAWO_PENU_NO -- 하나원기수번호 , T1.RELGN_SE_CD AS RELGN_SE_CD -- 종교구분코드 , T1.QLFC_INFO_MNG_NO AS QLFC_INFO_MNG_NO -- 자격정보관리번호 , T1.RCPT_PIC_NO AS RCPT_PIC_NO -- 접수담당자번호 , T1.RCPT_INST_NO AS RCPT_INST_NO -- 접수기관번호 , T1.CASE_TRPR_TYPE_SE_CD AS CASE_TRPR_TYPE_SE_CD -- 사례대상자유형구분코드 , T1.CASE_MNG_SE_CD AS CASE_MNG_SE_CD -- 사례관리구분코드 , T1.CASE_TRPR_SLCTN_YMD AS CASE_TRPR_SLCTN_YMD -- 사례대상자선정일자 , T1.CASE_TRPR_UNSL_CS_CN AS CASE_TRPR_UNSL_CS_CN -- 사례대상자미선정사유내용 , T1.PRTCR_NM_ENCPT AS PRTCR_NM -- 보호자명 , T1.TRPR_REL_SE_CD AS TRPR_REL_SE_CD -- 대상자관계구분코드 , T1.LIVTGT_YN AS LIVTGT_YN -- 동거여부 , T1.PRTCR_AGRE_YN AS PRTCR_AGRE_YN -- 보호자동의여부 , T1.PRVC_PVSN_AGRE_YN AS PRVC_PVSN_AGRE_YN -- 개인정보제공동의여부 , T1.SRVC_CTRT_AGRE_YN AS SRVC_CTRT_AGRE_YN -- 서비스계약동의여부 , T1.FRST_RGTR_ID AS FRST_RGTR_ID -- 최초등록자아이디 , T1.FRST_REG_DT AS FRST_REG_DT -- 최초등록일시 , T1.LAST_MDFR_ID AS LAST_MDFR_ID -- 최종수정자아이디 , T1.LAST_MDFCN_DT AS LAST_MDFCN_DT -- 최종수정일시 FROM SEA200 T1 /* 대상자정보 */ , SCA300 T2 /* 개인정보 */ WHERE 1 = 1
AND ( T1.TRPR_NM_ENCPT = #{TRPR_NM} -- 대상자명
OR T1.TRPR_TELNO_ENCPT = #{TRPR_TELNO} -- 대상자전화번호
OR T1.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT = #{MBL_TELNO} -- 휴대전화번호
OR T1.EML_ADDR_ENCPT = #{EML_ADDR} -- 이메일주소
OR T1.MSNGR_ID_ENCPT = #{MSNGR_ID} ) -- 메신저아이디
)
AND ( T1.TRPR_TELNO_ENCPT = #{TRPR_TELNO} -- 대상자전화번호
OR T1.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT = #{MBL_TELNO} -- 휴대전화번호
OR T1.EML_ADDR_ENCPT = #{EML_ADDR} -- 이메일주소
OR T1.MSNGR_ID_ENCPT = #{MSNGR_ID} ) -- 메신저아이디
)
AND ( T1.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT = #{MBL_TELNO} -- 휴대전화번호
OR T1.EML_ADDR_ENCPT = #{EML_ADDR} -- 이메일주소
OR T1.MSNGR_ID_ENCPT = #{MSNGR_ID} ) -- 메신저아이디
)
AND ( T1.EML_ADDR_ENCPT = #{EML_ADDR} -- 이메일주소
OR T1.MSNGR_ID_ENCPT = #{MSNGR_ID} ) -- 메신저아이디
)
AND ( T1.MSNGR_ID_ENCPT = #{MSNGR_ID} ) -- 메신저아이디
AND T1.TRPR_INFO_NO = #{TRPR_INFO_NO} -- 대상자정보번호(TR) AND NVL(T1.TRPR_NM_ENCPT,'X') = NVL(T1.TRPR_NM_ENCPT,'X') AND NVL(T1.TRPR_TELNO_ENCPT,'X') = NVL(T1.TRPR_TELNO_ENCPT,'X') AND NVL(T1.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT,'X') = NVL(T1.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT,'X') AND NVL(T1.EML_ADDR_ENCPT,'X') = NVL(T1.EML_ADDR_ENCPT,'X') AND NVL(T1.MSNGR_ID_ENCPT,'X') = NVL(T1.MSNGR_ID_ENCPT,'X')
ORDER BY T1.TRPR_INFO_NO, T1.TRPR_NM_ENCPT ) SELECT T.TRPR_INFO_NO AS TRPR_INFO_NO -- 대상자정보번호(TR) , T.INDV_IDNTFC_NO AS INDV_IDNTFC_NO -- 개인식별번호 , T.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD AS UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD -- 단위업무구분코드 , T.TRPR_NM AS TRPR_NM -- 대상자명 , T.TRPR_BRTH_YMD AS TRPR_BRTH_YMD -- 대상자출생일자 , T.SXDC_SE_CD AS SXDC_SE_CD -- 성별구분코드 , T.MRG_YN AS MRG_YN -- 결혼여부 , T.TRPR_TELNO AS TRPR_TELNO -- 대상자전화번호 , T.MBL_TELNO AS MBL_TELNO -- 휴대전화번호 , T.EML_ADDR AS EML_ADDR -- 이메일주소 , T.SNS_SE_CD AS SNS_SE_CD -- SNS구분코드 , T.MSNGR_ID AS MSNGR_ID -- 메신저아이디 , T.ZIP AS ZIP -- 우편번호 , T.PST_ADDR AS PST_ADDR -- 우편주소 , T.DADDR AS DADDR -- 상세주소 , CASE WHEN T.ZIP IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE '(' || T.ZIP || ') ' || T.PST_ADDR || ' ' || T.DADDR END AS TRPR_ADDR -- 대상자주소 , T.ACBG_SE_CD AS ACBG_SE_CD -- 학력구분코드 , T.GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD AS GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD -- 졸업상태구분코드 , T.GRADE_SE_CD AS GRADE_SE_CD -- 학년구분코드 , T.PSPT_ENG_FLNM AS PSPT_ENG_FLNM -- 여권영문성명 , T.TRPR_BCRN_TYPE_SE_CD AS TRPR_BCRN_TYPE_SE_CD -- 대상자배경유형구분코드 , T.TRPR_BCRN_TYPE_RM_NM AS TRPR_BCRN_TYPE_RM_NM -- 대상자배경유형비고명 , T.NLTY_NTN_SE_CD AS NLTY_NTN_SE_CD -- 국적국가구분코드 , T.ENTCNY_YMD AS ENTCNY_YMD -- 입국일자 , T.BRTH_NTN_SE_CD AS BRTH_NTN_SE_CD -- 출생국가구분코드 , T.GROWTH_NTN_SE_CD AS GROWTH_NTN_SE_CD -- 성장국가구분코드 , T.VISA_TYPE_SE_CD AS VISA_TYPE_SE_CD -- 비자유형구분코드 , T.HANAWO_PENU_NO AS HANAWO_PENU_NO -- 하나원기수번호 , T.RELGN_SE_CD AS RELGN_SE_CD -- 종교구분코드 , T.QLFC_INFO_MNG_NO AS QLFC_INFO_MNG_NO -- 자격정보관리번호 , T.RCPT_PIC_NO AS RCPT_PIC_NO -- 접수담당자번호 , ( SELECT X.FLNM FROM SCA100 X WHERE X.ENFSN_NO = T.RCPT_PIC_NO ) AS RCPT_PIC_NM , T.RCPT_INST_NO AS RCPT_INST_NO -- 접수기관번호 , ( SELECT X.INST_NM FROM SAA000 X WHERE X.INST_NO = T.RCPT_INST_NO ) AS RCPT_INST_NM , T.CASE_TRPR_TYPE_SE_CD AS CASE_TRPR_TYPE_SE_CD -- 사례대상자유형구분코드 , T.CASE_MNG_SE_CD AS CASE_MNG_SE_CD -- 사례관리구분코드 , T.CASE_TRPR_SLCTN_YMD AS CASE_TRPR_SLCTN_YMD -- 사례대상자선정일자 , T.CASE_TRPR_UNSL_CS_CN AS CASE_TRPR_UNSL_CS_CN -- 사례대상자미선정사유내용 , T.PRTCR_NM AS PRTCR_NM -- 보호자명 , T.TRPR_REL_SE_CD AS TRPR_REL_SE_CD -- 대상자관계구분코드 , T.LIVTGT_YN AS LIVTGT_YN -- 동거여부 , T.PRTCR_AGRE_YN AS PRTCR_AGRE_YN -- 보호자동의여부 , T.PRVC_PVSN_AGRE_YN AS PRVC_PVSN_AGRE_YN -- 개인정보제공동의여부 , T.SRVC_CTRT_AGRE_YN AS SRVC_CTRT_AGRE_YN -- 서비스계약동의여부 , T.FRST_RGTR_ID AS FRST_RGTR_ID -- 최초등록자아이디 , T.FRST_REG_DT AS FRST_REG_DT -- 최초등록일시 , T.LAST_MDFR_ID AS LAST_MDFR_ID -- 최종수정자아이디 , T.LAST_MDFCN_DT AS LAST_MDFCN_DT -- 최종수정일시 FROM V_TRPR_IDNTFC T WHERE 1 = 1 ORDER BY T.TRPR_INFO_NO, T.TRPR_NM
